formal_quality_execution: Two independent model processes, baseline and final, overlap on the same 16-logical-processor host. Each uses eight Torch threads and a separate corpus embedding cache.
timing_scope: Per-question wall times are diagnostic only. Formal run means are not a controlled latency comparison because the runs share CPU resources. The earlier three DEV core variants were measured separately.
selection: Final production choices fixed before formal output inspection; no further score-guided tuning.
reproduction_overlap: A preselected twelve-output Linux reproduction sample also runs with two Torch threads and a two-CPU container limit while the formal runs are in progress. All per-question wall times remain diagnostic, not a controlled latency comparison.

post_measurement_tooling_changes.scope: Snapshot preparation now copies measured files only; saved-alignment validation rebuilds existing PDF normalization instead of requiring raw substrings.
post_measurement_tooling_changes.replay_scope: Outer preparation uses the repaired tool; inference runs the exact preserved snapshot.
